01 / THE CHALLENGE

The challenge

AI-agent opportunities can sound broad until they are connected to a real process. The task was to identify practical use cases in banking, e-commerce and operations.

02 / THE APPROACH

The approach

Mapped workflows across the three domains, identified opportunities for AI agents and translated the findings into product demos.

03 / WHAT CHANGED

What changed

Turned workflow analysis into demonstrable product concepts. No production adoption or efficiency metric is reported for this work.

THE TAKEAWAY

Start with the process and its friction. The technology becomes easier to evaluate when the job it needs to do is specific.

Based on my résumé. Work streams within the same company are presented separately to explain their distinct focus; prototype and pilot outcomes are identified where relevant.
